basic_details.job_title: UoH Senior Project Associate/Project Associate II Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The School of Chemistry, University of Hyderabad, has invited applications from Indian Nationals for one Senior Project Associate/Project Associate-II post on the project "Synthesis and scale-up of Quinol-based curing agent for composite propellant", funded by DFTM under DIA-CoE. The pay is Rs. 42,000 total (Rs. 54,600 including HRA of Rs. 12,600), the essential qualification is MSc. Chemistry, preferably Organic Chemistry, and applications on plain paper must be emailed to [email protected] so that they are received by 27 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Write the application on plain paper.
Enclose self-attested copies of all certificates in support of the information furnished in the application.
Email the filled-in application to [email protected].
Make sure the application is received by 27 November 2026, the last date for receipt printed in the notice.
The notice does not give an email subject line or a format for the application.
important_instructions: The appointment is purely temporary, and appointees have no right to claim any regular appointment in the University. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the written test/skill test or at the time of joining. Only eligible candidates will be informed by email/letter at a later date.

content_sections.heading: About UoH
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the School of Chemistry, University of Hyderabad, under Form A for recruitment of positions in a research project. The project is funded by DFTM under DIA-CoE, University of Hyderabad, and the notice is signed by the Project Investigator.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian Nationals may apply. The qualification and experience printed for the post are below. Experience: Two Years of experience in R&D in industrial/academic institutions/Science and Technology organizations. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

rows.desirable: Experience in synthetic organic chemistry (2+ years)

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The fellowship/honorarium/stipend is Rs. 42,000 total, which is Rs. 54,600 including HRA. The HRA is printed as Rs. 12,600. The post is initially for one year and extendable till the end of the project, subject to satisfactory performance.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for UoH Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Write the application on plain paper. Enclose self-attested copies of all certificates in support of the information furnished in the application. Email the filled-in application to [email protected] . Make sure the application is received by 27 November 2026, the last date for receipt printed in the notice. The notice does not give an email subject line or a format for the application.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice mentions a written test/skill test and says that only eligible candidates will be informed by email/letter at a later date. It does not give a test date, venue, pattern or marking scheme.
